Restore the unmodified inventory pane colors for this category.
Tint this display category in inventory panes.

Return items remapped to this category to their organizedCategories default. Applies to the current save or session when those persistence options are on.

Delete the selected custom display category. Items using it return to the organizedCategories default.

Reorder how inventory categories are sorted.
Clear all saved display category overrides and restore organizedCategories defaults?
Removes every saved manual DisplayCategory remap and restores the organizedCategories defaults. Takes effect immediately.
Manual overrides: persist only per save
When enabled, manual display-category overrides are stored with the current save instead of applying to every save.
Manual overrides: persist only per session
When enabled, overrides last only until you load another save or quit. Takes effect after a reload.
When enabled, organizedCategories replaces item display names (Type - Permutation). Turn this off to keep vanilla and other mods' names. Takes effect after a reload.
